settings.heading: Tracked there.
settings.text: Every order leaves the workshop within two business days and travels tracked, door to door. If it isn't right, sending it back costs you nothing — that's the whole policy.

settings.heading: From the bench to your
settings.text: Orders are cut from the shelf and boxed within two business days. Delivery takes 3–5 business days across India, tracked the whole way — you get the tracking link the moment it ships. Shipping is free over the threshold shown in the bar at the top of the page.

settings.heading: Change your mind,
settings.text: Thirty days, no questions. Keep the box, wear them indoors, and if they're not right we arrange the pickup — you never stand in a courier line. Size exchanges are free in both directions, and refunds land within 5–7 business days of the return reaching us.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Within 2 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email the moment it leaves the workshop.

settings.question: What does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Free on qualifying orders — the current threshold shows in the announcement bar. Below it, the exact rate shows at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: How do I return or exchange a pair?
settings.answer: Write to us from the contact page with your order number. We arrange pickup from your door — returns post-paid, exchanges free both directions.

settings.question: When do I get my refund?
settings.answer: Within 5–7 business days of the return reaching the workshop, to your original payment method.
